positive_terms: Third-party standard of conduct used in policy encourages step-wise approach and continuous improvement in standard and its application of better management practices and requires establishment of meaningful targets and specific milestones to indicate progress against principles and criteria over time
第三方行为标准的渐进改进与目标设置
说明第三方行为标准是否鼓励渐进式改进和持续提升最佳实践，并要求设置有意义的阶段性目标与里程碑。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
